news.titleEn: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
news.conclusionEn: US stocks crashed on Thursday as the AI trade unraveled: the Nasdaq fell 5.5% into correction, the S&P 500 lost 4.4% and the Dow dropped about 1,800 points.
news.conclusionZh: AI股崩盘，纳指暴跌5.5%进入回调，道指跌约1800点。
news.whyEn: Investors fear the Democratic midterm sweep will slow the AI data-center buildout that has powered global stock gains all year.
news.whyZh: 市场担心民主党掌控国会后会拖慢AI数据中心建设，动摇全年牛市的核心支柱。
news.detailEn: Nvidia fell more than 9% and lost almost $450 billion in market value, while AMD, Micron and Applied Materials posted double-digit drops; the Philadelphia chip index fell about 12%, its second-worst day on record. Qualcomm added to the pain with weak guidance, and Musk's Tesla and SpaceX each fell more than 9%. Voters also rejected 40 of 41 local data-center ballot measures across 10 states, reinforcing worries about a political backlash against AI infrastructure. The VIX fear gauge jumped nearly 70%, and attention now turns to whether the selloff spreads into credit and the broader economy.
news.detailZh: 英伟达跌超9%，单日市值蒸发近4500亿美元；AMD、美光、应用材料跌幅都超过10%，费城半导体指数跌约12%，创史上第二大单日跌幅。高通疲弱的业绩指引雪上加霜，马斯克旗下特斯拉和SpaceX也都跌超9%。在10个州的41项地方数据中心公投中，有40项被否决，加深了市场对AI基础设施遭政治反弹的担忧。恐慌指数VIX飙升近70%，接下来要看抛售是否蔓延到信贷市场和实体经济。

news.titleEn: Asia stocks crumble after AI rout rocks US markets
news.conclusionEn: Asian markets plunged on Friday after Wall Street's AI rout, with South Korea's Kospi falling about 8% and triggering a circuit breaker while Japan's Nikkei dropped about 6%.
news.conclusionZh: 亚股周五暴跌，韩国Kospi跌约8%触发熔断，日经跌约6%。
news.whyEn: Asia's chip giants are the core suppliers of the AI boom, so any slowdown in US data-center spending hits Korea, Taiwan and Japan hardest.
news.whyZh: 亚洲芯片巨头是AI浪潮的核心供应商，美国数据中心投资放缓对日韩台冲击最大。
news.detailEn: SK Hynix fell 11.7%, Samsung Electronics nearly 10% and TSMC 8.5%, while Taiwan's main index also sank more than 8% and SoftBank Group slid 11%. Trading on the Kospi was halted for 20 minutes after the circuit breaker kicked in. Reuters said investors fear tighter regulatory scrutiny and a slowdown in AI build-out after Democrats won control of Congress. With these markets heavily concentrated in a few chip stocks, further volatility is likely until the AI demand outlook becomes clearer.
news.detailZh: SK海力士跌11.7%，三星电子跌近10%，台积电跌8.5%，台湾加权指数跌超8%，软银集团跌11%。Kospi触发熔断后暂停交易20分钟。路透指出，投资者担心民主党掌控国会后会加强监管并放缓AI建设。由于这些市场高度集中于少数芯片股，在AI需求前景明朗之前，波动可能持续。

news.titleEn: Bank of England Unanimously Hikes Rates, Warns of 4.9% Inflation
news.conclusionEn: The Bank of England raised its key rate by a quarter point to 4%, its first hike since 2023, and warned UK inflation will climb to nearly 5% next year.
news.conclusionZh: 英国央行加息25基点至4%，为2023年以来首次加息。
news.whyEn: It shows the Iran-war energy shock is pushing major central banks back toward tightening, which raises mortgage and borrowing costs for UK households and firms.
news.whyZh: 说明伊朗战争带来的能源冲击正把主要央行推回加息路径，英国房贷和融资成本上升。
news.detailEn: All nine policymakers voted to raise rates, with external member Catherine Mann pushing for a bigger half-point move. UK inflation was 3.5% in September, and the BOE now expects it to peak close to 5% in the second quarter of 2027, driven by months of high energy prices. Governor Andrew Bailey said he could see the argument for a further increase before taking a more conditional approach. The next decision is due on December 17, and markets will watch energy prices and the Iran talks for clues on another hike.
news.detailZh: 九名委员全部投票支持加息，其中外部委员凯瑟琳·曼主张一次加息50个基点。英国9月通胀为3.5%，央行预计受长期高能源价格推动，通胀将在2027年第二季度升至接近5%的峰值。行长贝利表示，有理由再加息一次，之后再采取更依赖数据的做法。下一次议息会议在12月17日，市场将关注能源价格和伊朗谈判进展，判断是否会再次加息。

news.titleEn: Iran War Updates: More ships attacked in Persian Gulf, oil prices rebound slightly after post-midterm plunge
news.conclusionEn: Several tankers were hit by mines or projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz and off Qatar, and Brent crude rebounded 2.2% to about $96.70.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡附近多艘油轮遇袭，布伦特油价反弹至约96.7美元。
news.whyEn: Attacks on shipping undercut hopes that the midterm results would quickly bring a deal to reopen Gulf shipping lanes, keeping energy prices and inflation high.
news.whyZh: 航运遇袭打击了中期选举后快速达成协议、重开海湾航道的期待，能源和通胀压力难降。
news.detailEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a tanker hit a mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz, and another tanker was struck by two projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Qatar. The oil rebound followed a nearly 9% plunge on Wednesday, when markets bet the midterm results would speed up an end to the war. On the diplomatic side, Oman is discussing a joint traffic-control system for the strait with Iran, and Iranian officials held talks with Russia's Putin. Oil prices will stay highly sensitive to any sign of a ceasefire or fresh escalation.
news.detailZh: 伊朗革命卫队称，一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以东触雷起火，另一艘油轮在卡塔尔以北约50海里处被两枚不明飞行物击中。油价反弹前，周三曾因市场押注中期选举会加速结束战争而暴跌近9%。外交方面，阿曼正与伊朗商讨海峡联合通航管控机制，伊朗官员还与普京会面。油价接下来仍会对停火信号或冲突升级高度敏感。

news.titleEn: Stock futures fall after Nasdaq correction; Japan's Nikkei 225 enters bear market: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: US stock futures kept falling Thursday night, and the October jobs report due Friday is now the next big test for markets.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货继续下跌，周五10月非农就业报告成为下一关键考验。
news.whyEn: After a historic tech selloff, weak jobs data could add recession fears on top of AI worries, while strong data could revive rate-hike bets.
news.whyZh: 科技股暴跌之后，就业数据偏弱会叠加衰退担忧，偏强则可能重燃加息预期。
news.detailEn: S&P 500 futures fell 0.6% and Nasdaq-100 futures dropped 0.8% after the cash session, while Japan's Nikkei 225 slid into a bear market, more than 20% below its June peak. The Magnificent Seven lost more than $1 trillion in market value on Thursday, and Nvidia turned negative for 2026. Economists expect the October payrolls report to show only about 59,000 jobs added with unemployment at 4.2%. Together with the BOE hike and high oil prices, the data will shape expectations for the Federal Reserve's next move.
news.detailZh: 收盘后标普500期货跌0.6%，纳指100期货跌0.8%；日经225指数较6月高点下跌超20%，正式进入熊市。「七巨头」周四合计市值蒸发超1万亿美元，英伟达年内涨幅转负。经济学家预计10月新增就业仅约5.9万人，失业率维持4.2%。结合英国央行加息和高油价，这份数据将影响市场对美联储下一步动作的判断。

news.titleEn: Airbnb Q3 Earnings, Revenue Rise; Shares Jump After Hours
news.conclusionEn: Airbnb beat third-quarter forecasts with $4.87 billion in revenue and $3.16 EPS, raised guidance and announced a $12 billion buyback, sending shares higher after hours.
news.conclusionZh: Airbnb三季度营收和利润均超预期，宣布120亿美元回购。
news.whyEn: It is a rare bright spot amid the tech rout and signals that global travel demand remains resilient despite the war and high energy prices.
news.whyZh: 是科技股暴跌中的少见亮点，说明战争和高油价下全球旅游需求依然坚挺。
news.detailEn: Revenue grew at its fastest pace in more than three years, beating the FactSet estimate of $4.75 billion, and earnings per share topped the $2.85 consensus. Airbnb guided fourth-quarter revenue to $3.22 billion to $3.28 billion, above the $3.16 billion expected, and raised its full-year growth forecast. The company also unveiled a $12 billion share repurchase program, a sign of confidence in its cash flow. CNBC reported the stock jumped about 11% in extended trading, a sharp contrast with AI-linked names.
news.detailZh: 营收增速创三年多来最快，高于FactSet预期的47.5亿美元，每股收益也超过2.85美元的市场预期。公司给出的四季度营收指引为32.2亿至32.8亿美元，高于预期的31.6亿美元，并上调全年增长预测。Airbnb还宣布120亿美元股票回购计划，显示对现金流的信心。据CNBC报道，股价盘后大涨约11%，与AI相关股票形成鲜明对比。

businessTips.explanationEn: The anchoring effect is the tendency to rely too heavily on the first number or piece of information we see when making judgments. In business, the first price, salary figure or estimate mentioned often sets the reference point for the whole discussion. Knowing this helps you set smart anchors in negotiations and spot when you are being anchored by someone else.
businessTips.explanationZh: 锚定效应是指人在做判断时，会过度依赖最先看到的数字或信息。在商业中，最先提出的价格、薪资或预估，往往会成为整场讨论的参照点。理解它，既能帮你在谈判中主动设定有利的「锚」，也能察觉自己是否被别人的锚牵着走。
businessTips.exampleEn: A cleaning company that lists a premium deep-clean package at $400 next to a standard clean at $180 makes the standard option feel like good value. In a salary talk, naming a well-researched number first usually pulls the final offer closer to it.
businessTips.exampleZh: 清洁公司把400澳元的深度清洁套餐放在180澳元标准清洁旁边，标准套餐就显得很划算。谈薪资时，先报出一个有依据的数字，最终结果通常会更靠近它。

businessTips.explanationEn: MOQ is the smallest number of units a supplier will produce or sell in one order. It directly decides how much cash you must tie up in stock before you sell anything. For small side businesses, negotiating a low MOQ or finding suppliers with flexible MOQs is key to testing products without overcommitting money.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小起订量（MOQ）是供应商一次愿意生产或出售的最少数量。它直接决定你在卖出任何东西之前要压多少现金在库存上。对小副业来说，争取较低的起订量或找到起订灵活的供应商，是低风险测试新产品的关键。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a factory demands 1,000 custom mugs at $4 each, you risk $4,000 before knowing demand; a print-on-demand supplier with no MOQ costs more per unit but lets you test with zero inventory. Many sellers start with on-demand, then switch to bulk orders once sales are proven.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果工厂要求定制杯子起订1000个、每个4美元，你在验证需求前就要押上4000美元；而无起订量的按需印刷供应商单价更高，却能零库存试水。很多卖家先用按需生产，销量验证后再转为批量采购。

businessTips.explanationEn: The VIX measures the market's expectation of S&P 500 volatility over the next 30 days, based on options prices, and is often called Wall Street's fear gauge. Readings below about 15 usually signal calm markets, while readings above 30 signal stress. It helps investors judge sentiment and the cost of hedging, but it does not predict the market's direction.
businessTips.explanationZh: VIX根据期权价格计算市场对标普500未来30天波动率的预期，常被称为华尔街「恐慌指数」。一般低于15代表市场平静，高于30代表市场紧张。它能帮助投资者判断情绪和对冲成本，但并不能预测涨跌方向。
businessTips.exampleEn: On November 5, 2026, the VIX jumped nearly 70% to about 28 as tech stocks crashed. Long-term investors often treat VIX spikes as a reminder to stick to their plan rather than panic-sell, since extreme fear has historically appeared near short-term lows.
businessTips.exampleZh: 2026年11月5日科技股暴跌时，VIX单日飙升近70%至约28。长期投资者常把VIX飙升视为坚持原定计划、不恐慌抛售的提醒，因为历史上极度恐慌往往出现在短期低点附近。
